Type: table
Name: Phoenix Home Tilburg Wood End Table with Drawer and Lower Shelf, Forest Oak
Colors: Oak
Materials: Wood
Wood end table with a small footprint; works well next to a reading chair, recliner, or couch Ruggedly built with solid wood for long-lasting strength and enjoyment Hand-applied multi-step finish; wood-grain accents bring natural warmth to any room Lower shelf for added storage or display; pull-out drawer with attractive metal hardware Measures 18 inches in diameter by 24 inches high; easy assembly (simply attach the legs and slide in the drawer)
